## Overview

Checkbox is the binary form control: a square indicator paired with an optional label and an optional description. Four variant axes drive it — `Selection` carries the real value (`Unchecked`, `Checked`, `Indeterminate`), `State` covers the five interaction states, `Size` scales the box, glyph, gap and type ramp in lockstep, and `Intent` switches the whole ramp to the invalid-form palette.

The single structural idea worth knowing: **the box height equals the label line-height at every size** (16 / 20 / 24). The root row top-aligns its children, so the control and the first line of the label sit on the same baseline box with no optical nudge, and a wrapped label or an added description grows downward without moving the box.

Focus is drawn by a dedicated ring rectangle positioned outside the auto-layout flow — not as a border — so showing focus never reflows the row.

**Variant axes.** 4 axes across 90 variants — **Selection** (Unchecked, Checked, Indeterminate; default `Unchecked`); **State** (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled; default `Default`); **Size** (Medium, Large, Small; default `Medium`); **Intent** (Default, Error; default `Default`).

### Composition

- **Icon / check** (referenced — `55:14`) — the checked glyph. Presentational.
- **Icon / minus** (referenced — `420:66`) — the indeterminate glyph. Presentational. Created for this component.
- _Decorative children: 1 (Focus Ring) — documented inline under Structure._

## API

> `Selection` and `State` are not the same kind of thing. `Selection` is the control's value and maps to real props. `State` is design-only: `Hover`, `Pressed` and `Focus` exist so a mock can show them, but in code they are `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible`, owned by the component. Only `State=Disabled` maps to a prop.
>
> `Indeterminate` is a presentation of a parent checkbox whose children are partly checked. It is never a value the user can select: activating an indeterminate checkbox moves it to `Checked`. In the DOM it is not a third value of `checked` — it is the separate `input.indeterminate` property.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | The control's value. Maps to Figma `Selection=Checked` / `Unchecked`. |
| `indeterminate` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Renders the dash glyph and reports `aria-checked="mixed"`. Takes precedence over `checked` visually. Set via the DOM property, not the attribute. |
| `label` | string | (string) | – | Visible text. The design source ships "Label" as placeholder copy, not a runtime default. |
| `description` | string | (string) | `none` | Supporting copy under the label. When absent, the description node is not rendered. |
| `size` | enum | small \| medium \| large | `medium` | Scales box, glyph, gap and type together. |
| `invalid` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Maps to Figma `Intent=Error`. Recolours box and description; exposes `aria-invalid="true"`. |
| `disabled` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Applies the disabled treatment and makes the control non-interactive. |

### Figma-only properties

These exist on the component set for mock-building and have no code counterpart:

| Figma property | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | TEXT | `"Label"` | Placeholder copy. |
| `Description` | TEXT | `"Description text"` | Placeholder copy. |
| `Show Label` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Toggles the whole **Text** block (label *and* description). Set to `false` for a bare box — e.g. a checkbox in a table row header. The row gap collapses with it. |
| `Show Description` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Toggles the description line only. Requires `Show Label=true` to be visible. |

### Examples

| # | Configuration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `label="Send me trip updates"` | Default medium checkbox. |
| 2 | `label="Select all"`, `indeterminate` | Parent of a partly-checked group. Activating it checks every child. |
| 3 | `label="I accept the terms"`, `invalid`, `description="This field is required."` | Invalid state; the description carries the error message and is wired via `aria-describedby`. |
| 4 | `checked`, `disabled` | Inert, pre-selected. Still exposed to assistive tech. |
| 5 | `size="small"`, `Show Label=false` | Bare box for a data-table selection column; the accessible name must then come from `aria-label`. |

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Checkbox (component set · 427:62)
├─ Focus Ring (rectangle) · decorative · a11y-hidden · absolute, outside layout flow
├─ Box (frame) · the control surface
│  └─ Indicator (instance · Icon / check | Icon / minus) · referenced · a11y-hidden
└─ Text (frame · vertical)
   ├─ Label (text)
   └─ Description (text) · hidden by default
```

The root is a horizontal auto-layout row, `counterAxisAlignItems = MIN` (top), zero padding, transparent fill, `clipsContent = false` so the focus ring can overhang.

### Dimensions

`Size` is the only dimension-affecting axis. `Selection`, `State` and `Intent` leave every measurement identical.

| Property | Small | Medium | Large | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Box width / height | 16 | 20 | 24 | `checkbox/control-size-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Indicator glyph | 12 | 16 | 20 | `checkbox/icon-size-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Box corner radius | 2 | 4 | 4 | `checkbox/radius-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Box border width | 1 | 1 | 1 | `checkbox/border-width` |
| Box → text gap | 8 | 8 | 12 | `checkbox/gap-{sm,md,lg}` |
| Label → description gap | 4 | 4 | 4 | `checkbox/gap-text` |
| Label type | 12 / 16 | 14 / 20 | 16 / 24 | `fontSize/*` + `lineHeight/*`, Lato Regular |
| Description type | 12 / 16 | 12 / 16 | 14 / 20 | `fontSize/*` + `lineHeight/*`, Lato Regular |
| Focus ring outset | 4 | 4 | 4 | `checkbox/focus-ring-offset` (2) + `checkbox/focus-ring-width` (2) |

Box height equals label line-height at every size, which is what makes the top-aligned row land correctly.

## Color

Token names follow `checkbox/{property}-{selection}-{intent}-{state}`, where `intent` is omitted for `Default` and `Checked`/`Indeterminate` share the `selected` ramp.

`State=Focus` reuses the `default` colour suffix and adds the ring — focus changes nothing but the ring.

### Box fill — `checkbox/bg-*`

| Selection | Intent | Default | Hover | Pressed | Disabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unchecked | Default | `color.bg-fill` | `color.bg-surface-brand` | `color.bg-surface-brand-hover` | `color.bg-surface-disabled` |
| Unchecked | Error | `color.bg-fill` | `color.bg-surface-warning` | `color.bg-surface-warning-hover` | `color.bg-surface-disabled` |
| Selected | Default | `color.bg-fill-brand` | `color.bg-fill-brand-hover` | `color.bg-fill-brand-pressed` | `color.bg-fill-disabled-strong` |
| Selected | Error | `color.bg-fill-warning-strong` | `color.bg-fill-warning-strong-hover` | `color.bg-fill-warning-strong-pressed` | `color.bg-fill-disabled-strong` |

### Box border — `checkbox/border-*`

| Selection | Intent | Default | Hover | Pressed | Disabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unchecked | Default | `color.border-strong` | `color.border-brand` | `color.border-brand-pressed` | `color.border-disabled-strong` |
| Unchecked | Error | `color.border-warning-strong` | `color.border-warning-strong-hover` | `color.border-warning-strong-pressed` | `color.border-disabled-strong` |
| Selected | Default | `color.border-brand` | `color.border-brand-hover` | `color.border-brand-pressed` | `color.border-disabled-strong` |
| Selected | Error | `color.border-warning-strong` | `color.border-warning-strong-hover` | `color.border-warning-strong-pressed` | `color.border-disabled-strong` |

Border and fill resolve to the same hex in every selected state, so the box reads as a solid chip rather than a filled box with a rim. Both are still bound separately so the ramps can diverge later.

Disabled collapses to the neutral ramp in both intents — an inert control should not also shout "error".

### Indicator glyph — `checkbox/icon-*`

Only rendered when selected. Default / Hover / Pressed all use `color.icon-brand-on-bg-fill` (Default intent) or `color.icon-warning-on-bg-fill-strong` (Error); Disabled uses `color.icon-on-bg-fill-disabled-strong`.

### Text and focus

| Token | Value | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `checkbox/label-default` | `color.text-primary` | Label, all states except Disabled |
| `checkbox/label-disabled` | `color.text-disabled` | Label, Disabled |
| `checkbox/description-default` | `color.text-secondary` | Description, Default intent |
| `checkbox/description-error` | `color.text-warning` | Description, Error intent |
| `checkbox/description-disabled` | `color.text-disabled` | Description, Disabled |
| `checkbox/focus-ring` | `color.border-focus` | Ring, Default intent |
| `checkbox/focus-ring-error` | `color.border-warning-strong` | Ring, Error intent |

The label stays neutral in the Error intent. The box and the description carry the error so it reads as one message, not two.

## Accessibility

### Contrast

Measured against `#ffffff`. Disabled pairs are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11 and are not listed.

| Pair | Ratio | Required | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unchecked border `#737373` | 4.74:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Checked box `#0067E8` | 5.12:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Check glyph on brand | 5.12:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Check glyph on error `#C10007` | 6.42:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Error border `#C10007` | 6.42:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Focus ring `#0681FF` | 3.76:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | Pass |
| Label `#0A0A0A` | 19.80:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Description `#525252` | 7.81:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |
| Error description `#C10007` | 6.42:1 | 4.5:1 (1.4.3) | Pass |

The unchecked border is why `color.border-strong` was added to the semantic tier. The existing `color.border` (`#D4D4D4`) measures **1.48:1** and fails 1.4.11 — it is a divider colour, not a control boundary.

**`color.border-strong` is `neutral.500` (`#737373`), the lightest neutral that meets WCAG 1.4.11.** It measures 4.74:1 on white and 4.35:1 on the grey canvas. It was briefly lightened to `neutral.400` (`#A1A1A1`, 2.58:1) on 2026-09-28 as an accepted deviation, and moved back to `neutral.500` to restore compliance. The disabled outline, `color.border-disabled-strong` (`neutral.400`), is now visibly lighter than the enabled one.

### Semantics

| Platform | Mapping |
|---|---|
| Web | Native `<input type="checkbox">` preferred. Otherwise `role="checkbox"` + `tabindex="0"` + Space key handling. `aria-checked="true" \| "false" \| "mixed"`. Indeterminate is set via the `indeterminate` DOM property. `aria-invalid="true"` when invalid. `aria-describedby` points at the description node. `disabled` (or `aria-disabled` if the control must stay focusable). |
| iOS / VoiceOver | Single accessibility element. Traits `.button` + `.selected` when checked. Value announces "checked" / "unchecked" / "mixed". Description appended as `accessibilityHint`. |
| Android / TalkBack | `CheckBox` (or `Checkable`) with `isChecked`. Indeterminate has no native mapping — expose it through `stateDescription` ("partially checked"). Description via `contentDescription` composition or an associated caption. |

**Focus order.** One stop. The box, the glyph and the ring are presentational; the label supplies the accessible name. Clicking the label must toggle the control — associate it with `<label for>` or by wrapping.

**Precedence.** `disabled` wins over `invalid`: an inert control does not announce an error. `indeterminate` wins over `checked` for both rendering and `aria-checked`.

**Touch target.** The component hugs its content, so the Small box is 16 px — below the 44/48 px minimum. Expand the hit area in code to at least `checkbox/min-touch-target` (48) using padding or a pseudo-element, without changing the visual box. This is deliberately not modelled in Figma; see Known gaps.

## Known gaps

- **`checkbox/focus-ring-offset` is not bound in Figma.** The ring's absolute position and size are not variable-bindable properties, so the 4 px outset (offset 2 + width 2) is baked as geometry on each variant. The token is authoritative for code; if you change it, the Figma ring geometry must be updated by hand.
- **`checkbox/min-touch-target` is not represented in the component.** It is an implementation concern only — expanding the Figma component would have broken the box/line-height alignment that the layout depends on.
- **`Show Label` toggles the whole text block**, not just the label line. Named for the common case; documented here because the name under-describes it.
- **No dark mode.** All three variable collections are single-mode, matching Button. Adding modes is a token-tier change, not a component one.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** This file was hand-authored next to the Figma build. Re-run the `create-component-md` flow (README → "Generating a spec for a new component") to replace it with an extracted spec.

## Token reference

64 tokens under `component.checkbox` in `tokens/tokens.json`, mirrored 1:1 as `checkbox/*` in the Figma `component` collection:

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| `bg-*` | 16 |
| `border-*` | 16 |
| `icon-*` | 8 |
| `label-*` / `description-*` | 5 |
| `focus-ring*` (colour) | 2 |
| dimensions (`control-size`, `icon-size`, `radius`, `border-width`, `focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset`, `gap-*`, `min-touch-target`) | 17 |

Platform names follow the standard pipeline: `checkbox/bg-selected-hover` → `--checkbox-bg-selected-hover` (CSS) → `CosmosTokens.checkboxBgSelectedHover` (Swift / Kotlin) → `tokens.checkboxBgSelectedHover` (TS).

This component also added one semantic token: **`color.border-strong`** (`{color.neutral.500}`, see Contrast) — the interactive-control boundary colour. Reuse it for Radio, Switch and Input rather than reaching for `color.border`.
